response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial experience (GISCollective, Green Map) and low-latency systems work in DLang, but his C++ experience is dated (2014–2015) and recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and product development. He lacks direct experience with routing engines, map tiling pipelines, or navigation guidance systems, and has no Rust background, making him a partial fit for a C++-first routing data pipeline role.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience as founder of GISCollective and work with Green Map
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec) using async I/O and caching at Dunnhumby
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, Linux, Docker, and open-source contributions
concerns: C++ experience is limited and roughly a decade old; no Rust experience listed
No direct routing, navigation guidance, or map-tiling pipeline experience
Recent career trajectory (TypeScript/Node.js product work) diverges from systems-level C++ development
